reviews.t: Great product would recommend this to anybody!!!!!!!
reviews.x: This was a great product that straighten my beard immediately. Comfortable design and is designed where you will never burn yourself perfect for a personthe go just throw it in the bag and you're on your way I would definitely recommend this as a buy
I bought it for my husband as a gift. He uses the essential oils and the electric comb almost everyday. This made taking care of his beard so much easier. A great combination.

Really like the concept of this product. Well designed and works pretty good for beard and hair, unfortunately in less than two months of at-home use the black plastic pieces are starting to fall out. These pieces keep the ceramic heated elements from touching your skin so this is very unfortunate and potentially painful. Not sure if there is any underlying issue causing this defect or not, but also unsure if or how long I will be able to use this!

I am using this product everyday since it was delivered and it works great to straighten your hairs as well as beard. The heat levels can be set according to your needs. I used it to straighten my hairs and it gave me a new look altogether which looks good and now I feel more confident.

reviews.t: You won’t be disappointed. Must buy
reviews.x: I have a short/medium length beard and this product worked very well. My beard hair is thick, wavy, and somewhat dry. After brushing on the highest setting at all different directions to get all the hairs it came out so straight and so smooth like the hair on my head. The beard oil that came with it is amazing. It feels good and smells amazing.  Just noticed on the oil bottle that it can be applied in other areas of the body that have hair. Definitely an awesome bonus. Would love to buy more of

Honestly. It was good for about one month. Then all of a sudden the brush part that surrounds the heated teeth started to melt off. Here it is now about 3 months later and my beard brush is nearly unuseable due to there being little protection from the heat.

It seemed to do a decent job, but within a few uses the little plastic comb-nodules started falling off. After several more uses, there are only a few inner comb-nodules left.  It still kind of works, but not as well as initially...
I was so pleased with the two brushes I purchased for myself and my friend until the bristles broke off both. I threw them in the garbage after I burned my face. Very disappointed.
This is the beard brush to have!!! Great quality product with even greater results!!! The oil provided smells amazing and really brings out the quality of a beard!!!

I'm in the process of growing my beard out and I didn't want it to look all ratty, so I figured I would try a straightener.  The beard oil that comes with the straightener is amazing as well as the actual product.  It is smaller, which is great for getting the mustache as well as the beard.  There are 2 heat settings, I use the higher one for faster results.  Yes you will hear sizzling, it is not burning your hair off, relax.  That is part of the process. I personally haven’t used it, but my husband loves it! When I was first talking to him about this, he didn’t seem too keen on the idea of using one. But when it came, he saw how easy it was to use and has used it almost every day since I gave it to him! It heats up quick and only takes a few brushes through the beard to straighten it up. Paired with the oil it came with, it takes his manly beard to a whole new handsome level ❤️

I bought this product for my husband and he absolutely loves it. It heats up pretty fast and leaves my husbands beard nice and straight. I've actually used it on my hair as well and it works out pretty good. He also loves the smell of the beard oil and is really glad it came with. Everyone always asks how he gets his beard so nice and shiny and he tells him this product works!

Wow! This really worked good and was easy to use for my coarse beard. This is longest length of time that I've worn a beard (2 almost 3 months). It hasn't gotten very long yet but it's thick. This thing straighten it right on out, gave me a little length and made it softer. Good price. I'm very pleased

I bought this kind of product for my farther as a gift. It straightens his beard effectively and safely. With essential oils used, his beard looks brighter and cleaner. My father is so satisfied with the item. Now I'm gonna buy one for myself. A successful shopping and I definitely recommend it.

reviews.t: Does it job but low end quality
reviews.x: Feels light weight and it’s made thin plastic, overall feels cheap but it heats up fast and yes in fact it does straighten men’s beards. It takes multiple passes because the teeth on the brush are spaced to far apart so it’s hard to grab the hairs and straighten.

reviews.t: Great item and worth every penny!
reviews.x: I’ve been growing my beard for a while now and really wanted to try a heated straightener. I’m glad I picked this one. It great. Heats up fast, even in the higher temperature, easy to use, and great results. You won’t be disappointed with this purchase at all.

Think I fell victim to a bunch of fake reviews. The temperature switch only worked in one position and after 5 minutes it never really heated up.  Used to be able to find top quality products here but everything seems to be cheaply made.  Very disappointed.

reviews.t: does the job, and does it good
reviews.x: for the price ? come on now get it, !!! truly works great and what I like it is smaller I don't have a huge beard so a lot of those wide ones are over kill for me, this is perfect for a small or like my beard I consider it medium. And it heats up  very fast

reviews.t: For thick corse beard hair it’s ooookay not great
reviews.x: It’s ok for long thick corse beard hair. My hair Isn’t curly but it’s really wavy and curls a bit by my ears on my sideburns. It won’t straighten it completely after multiple combs. It’s straightens a little but not much on my beard.

I love my beard straightener.. it comes with awesome beard oil as well. I wish the oil was a bit bigger but it’s still ah awesome oil and straightener. It works great for my thick coarse hair. Definitely worth the money.
I used about 10-12 times and it was working beautifully, one day it just overheated and melted the plastic bristles and I didn’t notice and felt very hot on my face, luckily I didn’t burn myself.

reviews.t: Works great! Beard looks great too!
reviews.x: It works fantastic. I was apprehensive at first but it has worked great. The oil is really nice too! I've gotten many compliments on my beard since using it. Wife loves how my beard looks!
The straightener does not work straighten, atleast it does not for me. I am not sure if it does not get to the full temperature or just does not work but I would not suggest
In the past I could not control my beard from curling after growing past a few inches. Now it looks straight and longer. Wish I had this 15 years ago.

claims.text: Straightens beards effectively and quickly, including thick, coarse, and wavy hair.
Easy to use and heats up fast, making beard care more convenient.
The included beard oil is a well-liked bonus that smells great.
Durable design praised for safety and comfort, with no burning.
Plastic comb/bristle parts fall apart or melt within a few months of use.
